verdict.rationale: SavvyCal steers bookings toward better times rather than just the first open slot. It presents ranked availability windows to nudge recipients toward the optimal time, encourages booking near other meetings to avoid calendar fragmentation, and honors time-budget calendar events. It can also combine availability across teammates and external calendars, and lets recipients overlay their own calendar to find mutual times. However, this is rule-based ranking set by the host, not AI-driven, and nothing shows ongoing re-optimization after a meeting is booked. missing for 10: AI/ML-based selection of the best time, continuous optimization or automatic rescheduling of booked meetings, evidence that ranking weighs all attendees' preferences, independent or hands-on corroboration.
